newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - April 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - April 18.

text.p: These were the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Political parties to recommend inclusion of provisions to establish independent elections and police commissions in new constitution.
Presidential Commission inquiring into malpractices in public bodies questions former foreign minister, A.C.S. Hameed.
Sports and Youth Affairs minister S.B. Dissanayake says he will give evidence against his brother at inquiry into recent disturbances in Hanguranketha in central Sri Lanka.

Minister of Media Dharmasiri Senenayake says amendments to Broadcasting Authority bill can be made during parliament debate. A number of media organisations have filed petitions against the bill in the Supreme Court.
The parliamentary Select Committee working on the new constitution will also consider changes in election laws, says Justice and Constitutional Affairs minister, G.L. Peiris.
Twelve petitions against the controversial Broadcasting Authority Bill filed in Supreme Court.
